item.title: Global Economy at Risk: IEA Warns of ‘Very Big Threat' from Iran Conflict
item.description: The ongoing escalation in West Asia is beginning to strain global energy systems, with the International Energy Agency warning of widespread economic fallout as tensions intensify.

item.title: Randhawa Death Case: MPs Request HM to Assure Transfer of Case to CBI; Seek Look-Out Circular Against Accused
item.description: Four Members of Parliament, including Charanjit Singh Channi, have written to Home Minister Amit Shah seeking assurance for a CBI investigation into the death case of Gagandeep Singh Randhawa.

item.title: Strict action against anyone who violates the law; strict prohibition on cash, favors: CM Mann
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann on Monday said that strict action will be taken against anyone in Punjab, regardless of social status, who violates the law, while also warning against the use of cash and favors.

item.title: Rs 64,000 Crore Boost: Govt to Launch 7 Coal Gasification Projects to Cut Imports
item.description: India is set to roll out seven coal gasification projects with an estimated investment of Rs 64,000 crore across Maharashtra, Odisha and West Bengal, Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy informed the Rajya Sabha on Monday.

item.title: 36-Year-Old Air Force Staffer Arrested for Spying for Pakistan, Leaked Missile System Details
item.description: Sumit Kumar, a civilian MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff) at the Air Force Station Chabua in Dibrugarh, Assam, has been arrested by Rajasthan Intelligence and Air Force Intelligence in a joint operation.

item.title: Laljit Singh Bhullar arrested in connection with suicide case of Randhawa; Family demands CBI probe
item.description: Former Cabinet Minister Laljit Singh Bhullar has been arrested in connection with the suicide case of Gagandeep Singh Randhawa, District Manager of the Punjab Warehousing Corporation, in Amritsar, Punjab.

item.title: US Issues 2.5 Lakh Fewer Visas in 2025, Indians Among Most Affected
item.description: A noticeable drop in US visas for international students and families is emerging as a key trend in 2025, with Indians among the worst affected under policies of Donald Trump.

item.title: B.Ed Course to Remain Two Years, Govt Rules Out 1-Year Format
item.description: Speculation over a possible return of the one-year B.Ed programme has been put to rest, with the Centre confirming that no such change is currently being planned.

item.title: 529 Govt Companies Appoint Women Directors, 179 Still Without Representation
item.description: Out of 708 government-owned companies required to have at least one woman director on their boards, 179 currently have none. The Companies Act, 2013, makes it mandatory for certain public and listed companies to include at least one female director.

item.title: UPSC to Publish Provisional Prelims Answer Keys Starting 2026
item.description: The Union Public Service Commission will begin releasing provisional answer keys for the Civil Services Preliminary Examination starting from 2026. This change was announced in a written reply to the Rajya Sabha by Minister of State for Personnel, Jitendra Singh, and allows candidates to review their performance before the final results are declared.
